title: 龙国篇 第三十二章 神秘黑袍人龙国篇 第三十一章 雷帝斩刃
content_zh:
“哈哈哈哈……”梦曦的笑声在空气中回荡着，仿佛带着无尽的悲伤和绝望。她右眼角的泪水悄然滑落，如同晶莹的珍珠一般，闪耀着微弱的光芒。
“他真的好傻……竟然说出那样的话，说什么，要杀我就先从他的尸体上踏过。”梦曦喃喃自语着，声音充满了痛苦和无奈。随着这句话说出口，她左边的眼眶也湿润了起来，泪水顺着脸颊流淌而下。
梦曦：“忆君心似西江水，日夜东流无歇时。”
“阿恒，我的任务完成了，你的也一样。现在，我终于可以去找你了。”梦曦的目光望向远方，眼神中透露出一种坚定和决绝。
在梦曦即将彻底消散的瞬间，那如同黄粱一梦般的画面逐渐模糊起来
梦曦：“一执一念一浮生，一悲一喜一枉然，我世已终，你辈你定。”
此时此刻，梦曦在识海之中凝视了真的世界的叶恒，这也是最后一次，她眼中流露出一丝欣慰和释然，她微微一笑心中想对艾希说一些什么，但只能恨自己没有时间了。
“他…真的好像他啊，看来，他真的没骗我”随着笑容在脸上绽放，梦曦的身影也渐渐融入了识海的深处，最终完全消失不见。然而，就在她离去的那一刻，整个识海都弥漫着一种宁静而又神秘的气息，仿佛是在为这位勇敢而坚定的女子送行。
与此同时，现实世界中的叶恒似乎感受到了什么，他的心头涌起一股莫名的悲伤和失落。
泪水也在此刻不知不觉中流下，尽管他并不知道是怎么回事，但内心深处却有一种无法言喻的感觉，却始终能感觉自己失去了一个非常重要的人。
叶恒默默地站在原地，目光深情的凝视着艾希。
艾希也从苏醒中缓缓睁开眼睛，她静静地望着叶恒，而叶恒也同样凝视着她，两人目光交汇，饱含深情地对视着，这一刻仿佛时间都停滞了一般。叶恒眼中的泪水愈发汹涌，难以止住。
艾希轻声问道：“阿恒......你这是怎么了？”
叶恒喃喃自语道：“我也不知道，只是总感觉，好像有某种重要的东西离我而去了......”
艾希伸出手，轻轻抚摸着叶恒的脸庞，安慰道：“确实......刚才我遇到了龙帝之妻雷帝梦曦。说出来很可笑，连我自己都不敢相信，我竟然是她的转世人。”
叶恒皱起眉头，疑惑地说：“可是，为何她的离去会让我如此悲伤，甚至流下眼泪？”
艾希调皮地逗弄着叶恒，笑道：“这我可就不清楚啦，说不定你是龙帝龙恒的转世呢？”
叶恒陷入了沉思，他开始回忆起王座那时刻，心中涌起一种莫名的熟悉感。难道真如艾希所说，自己与龙帝之间存在着某种联系？这个念头在他脑海中盘旋不去。
随着思考的深入，叶恒决定要去探寻这个谜团背后的真相。他暗自下定决心，一定要找到答案，解开龙国之谜，同时也要搞清楚为何雷帝梦曦与龙帝龙恒的陨落。
艾希看着叶恒坚定的神情，心中不禁一动，她知道眼前的男子已经做好了面对未知挑战的准备。于是，她微笑着鼓励道：“无论前方等待着你的是什么，我都会一直陪伴在你身边。”

叶恒感激地看向艾希，紧紧握住她的手，两人的目光中充满了信任和爱意。在这片神秘的世界里，他们将携手并肩，共同揭开隐藏在深处的秘密。
“阿恒，你看我……”只见她轻盈地拿起雷帝斩刃，眼神闪烁着自信和决心。随着一声低喝，她身形一闪，瞬间进入了战斗状态。
“惶惶雷霆，一击万里；王者之姿，雷霆之怒！”伴随着激昂的口号声，她的动作如同行云流水般自然流畅，每一个招式都蕴含着无尽的力量和威势。斩刃在她手中舞动，犹如闪电划过天际，令人目不暇接。
她的身姿矫健而优雅，动作精准而有力，仿佛与雷帝斩刃融为一体。每一次挥刀都带着雷霆万钧之势，让人感受到一股无与伦比的震撼。在这一刻，她就是战场上的主宰，无人能敌。
突然，她猛地回头，目光与叶恒交汇。那一瞬间，时间仿佛凝固了，整个世界只剩下他们两个人。她的眼神中透露出温柔，让叶恒不禁为之倾倒。
武剑结束，她宛如仙子般从空中缓缓落下，轻盈地飘入叶恒的怀抱中。叶恒紧紧地拥抱着她，感受着她身上散发出的温暖气息。这一刻，他们仿佛忘却了周围的一切，沉浸在属于彼此的幸福时光里。
如此壮观的景象，想必会令无数人羡慕不已吧。
“真是令人难以置信，收服神器后的你竟然发生了如此巨大的变化！不仅成功晋升为&bp;S级武神，甚至连整个人的气质都在瞬间得到了极大的提升。等回到家后，我一定要好好地检查一下呢~”叶恒突然间的不正经令艾希不禁满脸傲娇起来。
艾希娇嗔道：“你别胡闹啦......师姐可是还在旁边看着呢！”
叶恒下意识地回头望了一眼艾米，却见到艾米正怒气冲冲的模样，不由得吓得他瞬间躲到了艾希的身后。
叶恒有些心虚地说道：“艾米姐，你...你别过来啊，我现在已经是&bp;A级武神了哦，就算和你同级，我也未必会输给你！”
艾米嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹狡黠的笑容：“是吗？那我倒要好好见识一下呢。”
叶恒有些慌张地喊道：“你...你别过来呀！”
就在两人即将要打起来的时候，艾希的一句话犹如一盆冷水般，瞬间将他们拉回到了正题上来。
content_en:
"Hahahaha..." Meng Xi's laughter echoed in the air, as if it was filled with endless sadness and despair. The tears from the corner of her right eye slipped quietly, shining like crystal pearls with a faint light.
"He is really stupid... He actually said such words. If he wanted to kill me, he would have to step over his body first." Meng Xi murmured to herself, her voice full of pain and helplessness. As these words came out, her left eye became moist, and tears flowed down her cheeks.
Meng Xi: "The heart of remembering you is like the water of the West River, flowing eastward day and night without rest."
"Ah Heng, my mission is completed, and so is yours. Now, I can finally go find you." Meng Xi looked into the distance, revealing a kind of firmness and determination in her eyes.
At the moment when the dream was about to completely dissipate, the picture that was like a yellow beam gradually blurred.
Meng Xi: "One attachment, one thought, one floating life, one sadness, one joy, one in vain. My life is over, and you will decide it for me."
At this moment, Mengxi stared at Ye Heng in the real world in the sea of consciousness. This was also the last time. There was a trace of joy and relief in her eyes. She smiled slightly and wanted to say something to Ai Xi, but she could only hate that she had no time.
"He... really looks like him. It seems that he really didn't lie to me." As a smile bloomed on his face, Meng Xi's figure gradually merged into the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, and finally disappeared completely. However, at the moment she left, the entire sea of ​​consciousness was filled with a quiet and mysterious atmosphere, as if she was bidding farewell to this brave and determined woman.
At the same time, Ye Heng seemed to feel something in the real world, and an inexplicable sadness and loss surged in his heart.
Tears were also shed unknowingly at this moment. Although he didn't know what was going on, there was an indescribable feeling deep in his heart, but he could always feel that he had lost a very important person.
Ye Heng stood silently, staring at Ai Xi affectionately.
Ai Xi also slowly opened her eyes from waking up. She looked at Ye Heng quietly, and Ye Heng also stared at her. Their eyes met and they looked at each other affectionately. It was as if time had stopped at this moment. The tears in Ye Heng's eyes became more and more violent and difficult to stop.
Ai Xi asked softly: "Ah Heng...what's wrong with you?"
Ye Heng murmured to himself: "I don't know either, I just always feel like something important has left me..."
Ai Xi stretched out her hand, gently touched Ye Heng's face, and comforted: "It is true... I just met the Thunder Emperor Mengxi, the wife of the Dragon Emperor. It's ridiculous to say it. Even I can't believe it. I am actually her reincarnation."
Ye Heng frowned and said doubtfully, "But why does her passing make me so sad and even shed tears?"
Ai Xi teased Ye Heng playfully and said with a smile, "I don't know about this. Maybe you are the reincarnation of Dragon Emperor Long Heng?"
Ye Heng fell into deep thought. He began to recall the moment on the throne, and an inexplicable feeling of familiarity arose in his heart. Is it true that as Ai Xi said, there is some kind of connection between himself and the Dragon Emperor? The thought lingered in his mind.
As his thinking deepened, Ye Heng decided to explore the truth behind this mystery. He secretly made up his mind to find the answer and solve the mystery of the Dragon Kingdom. He also wanted to understand why the Thunder Emperor Mengxi and the Dragon Emperor Long Heng fell.
Looking at Ye Heng's determined expression, Ai Xi couldn't help but feel something in her heart. She knew that the man in front of her was ready to face unknown challenges. So, she smiled and encouraged: "No matter what is waiting for you ahead, I will always be by your side."
Ye Heng looked at Ai Xi gratefully and held her hand tightly. Their eyes were full of trust and love. In this mysterious world, they will work hand in hand to uncover the secrets hidden in the depths."Ah Heng, look at me..." She picked up the Thunder Emperor Blade lightly, her eyes flashing with confidence and determination. With a low shout, she flashed and instantly entered a fighting state.
"The panic of thunder, a strike thousands of miles; the posture of a king, the fury of thunder!" Accompanied by the passionate slogan, her movements were as natural and smooth as clouds and flowing water, and every move contained endless power and power. The cutting blade danced in her hand, like lightning flashing across the sky, which was dizzying.
Her posture is strong and elegant, and her movements are precise and powerful, as if she is integrated with the Thunder Emperor's Blade. Every swing of the sword carries the force of thunder, making people feel an unparalleled shock. At this moment, she was the master of the battlefield, unrivaled.
Suddenly, she turned around suddenly and her eyes met Ye Heng's. At that moment, time seemed to freeze, and there were only two of them left in the whole world. There was tenderness in her eyes, which made Ye Heng fall in love with her.
After the sword fighting was over, she slowly fell from the air like a fairy, floating lightly into Ye Heng's arms. Ye Heng hugged her tightly, feeling the warm breath emanating from her body. At this moment, they seemed to have forgotten everything around them and were immersed in each other's happy time.
Such a spectacular sight must be the envy of countless people.
"It's unbelievable. You have undergone such a huge change after taking over the artifact! Not only was you successfully promoted to an S-class Martial God, but your whole temperament was greatly improved in an instant. When I get home, I must check it out~" Ye Heng's sudden impropriety made Ai Xi's face look arrogant.
Ai Xi said coquettishly: "Don't be ridiculous...Senior sister is still watching from the side!"
Ye Heng glanced back at Amy subconsciously, but when he saw Amy's angry look, he was so frightened that he instantly hid behind Ai Xi.
Ye Heng said with some guilt: "Sister Amy, you...don't come over here. I am already an A-level Martial God. Even if I am at the same level as you, I may not lose to you!"
The corners of Amy's mouth raised slightly, revealing a sly smile: "Really? Then I'd like to see it."
Ye Heng shouted in a panic: "You...don't come over!"
Just when the two were about to fight, Ai Xi's words were like a bucket of cold water, instantly bringing them back to the topic.
